blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — US President Donald Trump on Wednesday announced the conclusion of what he described as the “biggest trade deal” the United States has ever made with the Philippines, saying the agreement would further strengthen the two countries’ alliance. Speaking during a state luncheon hosted by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. in Manila, Trump said the trade agreement was a major achievement for both countries and described its terms as fair.
